solid white capsule; NOT native accent inset selection

tokens.value: borderless floating HUD, frosted rounded frame, no traffic lights

patterns.key_values: leading app identity + inline bezel-less search (leading magnifier) + trailing 3 circular SF-Symbol icon buttons (star/2x2-grid/export+badge); left-aligned to shared content inset

single horizontal row of equal-height content-type-aware clip cards (image thumb / text snippet / web screenshot / colour swatch / doc); each with footer meta = source favicon + relative time (left), size/bytes (right); even gaps > within-card padding; radius ~18-20pt; on #000 shelf
wide short borderless HUD; frosted-glass outer frame over pure-black content shelf; no traffic lights; capsule/circle affordances throughout
category chips = horizontal capsule 'tabs' with live counts (History/Prompts/Colors/Assets/Inspirations, each '24') + circular '+' add-collection; active = white fill, inactive = dark translucent

signature_moves: Content-type-aware clip cards — copied colour renders as a full-bleed colour card (#0080FF), image as thumbnail, URL as web screenshot, text as legible snippet; recognition-over-recall made structural
True-black (#000) gallery backdrop turning each preview card into a lit object, paired with a glass outer frame so it doesn't read flat
Counted collections as capsule tabs — reframes a clipboard manager as a creative asset library (Prompts/Colors/Assets/Inspirations)
Restrained accent-agnostic monochrome chrome — the only on-screen saturation is user content
defects: Selection grammar deviation — active chip is solid white fill + black text, not native accent-tinted inset-rounded selection (reads iOS/web segmented toggle)
Accent unbound — selection/focus bind to white, not the user's system accent; forfeits the 'accent is the user's' native rule
Circular-background toolbar buttons — vs native borderless monochrome symbols (soft; defensible on a glass HUD)
Low-contrast chrome risk — dark-gray circle buttons on black and dim gray count badges hover near 3:1/4.5:1 floors (estimated from compressed composite)

aesthetic.direction: committed dark content-shelf HUD — a deliberate direction (true-black stage, capsule-everything, content-as-hero cards), not a template default

psychology: Von Restorff (isolation) — the single white active chip pops against dark siblings; instant 'you are here'
Recognition over recall — content-aware previews let users spot a clip by its visual (the colour, the thumbnail) rather than reading text
Jakob's Law — adopts the established Paste horizontal-clipboard-shelf mental model clipboard-manager users already know
Miller's Law / chunking — clipboard chunked into ~5 named collections rather than one long undifferentiated history
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — high-polish dark gallery inflates perceived usability and trust
notes: MARKETING-COMPOSITE ONLY — no in-app screenshots supplied; the sole UI evidence is the app window inside a branded cover (Apple-style headline 'Copy once. Reuse anytime.', blurred landscape backdrop). Backdrop/headline are brand evidence, analysed separately from the window. App shown at INDETERMINATE scale: all absolute-pt tokens are estimated via an assumed ~1.85x composite scale from the macOS menu-bar clock ('09:41' ~24-26px); ratios trustworthy, absolutes not. No traffic lights (borderless HUD) so no chrome calibration. Lineage 'native' is med-confidence: macOS density + system font read native but heavy custom drawing hides framework tells and there is no chrome to confirm; could be macOS-correct SwiftUI. Menu bar top-right (search/wifi/09:41) is the desktop system bar, NOT app UI — used only for scale. Icon (blue vertical-gradient squircle + single white capsule bar, Big-Sur-era) noted as brand context in apps/supaste.md, not digested as a full icon (Workflow A only). 'Colors' collection and #0080FF card imply a designer/creative audience. Locale detail: '3,5 MB' uses comma decimal (EU).
